title: Kling Watermark Remover for Exported Image Frames
description: Use this Kling watermark remover for an authorized still frame saved as JPG, PNG, or WEBP. The current online tool processes images only.
heading: Kling Watermark Remover for Authorized Still Images
intro: Export a still frame from Kling content you may edit, then upload that image to the browser-based workflow. The tool does not accept video files and does not claim to remove invisible provenance information.

process.heading: How to Use the Kling Watermark Remover
process.intro: Start with a permitted frame and finish in three image-focused steps.

steps.title: Export a Still Frame
steps.description: Save the frame as JPG, PNG, or WEBP. The current workflow does not upload or process a complete video.

steps.title: Upload and Start
steps.description: Upload one image up to 10 MB, sign in with Google, and begin processing.

steps.title: Review the Image
steps.description: Inspect the returned image and download it only if the visible area and background look acceptable.

faq.heading: Questions About the Kling Watermark Remover
faq.intro: Learn about still-frame preparation, file limits, and responsible editing.

items.question: Can I upload a full Kling video?
items.answer: No. Export a still frame and upload it as JPG, PNG, or WEBP. Video formats are not supported.

items.question: Will every background look perfect?
items.answer: No result is guaranteed. Complex motion blur, textures, or subjects behind a visible mark may require manual review or editing.

items.question: Is WatermarkGemini affiliated with Kling AI or Kuaishou?
items.answer: No. WatermarkGemini is an independent image-cleanup tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Kling AI or Kuaishou.

items.question: What content may I process?
items.answer: Only process content you own or have permission to modify. Preserve required attribution and disclosures.
